purpose: Compare two fixed interval methods in development; do not select an alert rule automatically.
known_truth: Counts depend on unshifted outing state. Add effect times count to recent sums. The population pitch-weighted difference remains exactly effect.
effect_interpretation: One SD of the unweighted latent outing mean is a sensitivity illustration, not a practical baseball threshold.
empirical_pool: Reuse every saved reliability null context and its baseline-outing pool, through 2024 only.
zero_variance: Welch interval unavailable; preserve percentile point intervals and report both support rates.
numerical_rule: Eight float64 epsilons scaled to outing/window measurement levels handle constant ratios, coverage boundaries, and numerical zero widths. Apply to both methods; this is not a practical effect threshold.
usage_boundary: Both methods unavailable when either observed usage is zero or one.
widths: Do not clip intervals to the physical parameter range. Report width and common-supported trials.
stop_rule: Run this grid and these contexts once, preserve failures, and choose no automatic winner or outing cutoff. No 2025/2026 analysis or K/BB tuning.
